title: Silver Plus Account: Mobile banking and deposit limits
summary: This document covers the Silver Plus Account’s mobile check deposit limit ($5,000 daily total) and rules for outbound transfers via mobile/online banking (maximum $10,000 per day; scheduled transfers combined can’t exceed $10,000). It also notes the app feature “automatic round-up savings” (available: Yes) for a linked debit card.
faqs: What is the daily limit for mobile check deposits on my Silver Plus Account?
If I reach the $5,000 mobile deposit limit, can I deposit more checks the same day?
What is the maximum amount of outbound transfers per day via mobile/online banking?
If I schedule multiple transfers in one day, what total limit applies?
Does the Silver Plus app support automatic round-up savings on my linked debit card?
